legend.frozen: Frozen: computed from games before 2026-11-02 only, ratings fixed at that cutoff, committed 2026-11-10 (tag pred-2026-preQF) after the quarterfinals had started, and never re-run.
legend.walk_forward: Walk-forward: computed afterwards, each game using only games dated before it and adding results game by game. Not a live prediction.
legend.sensitivity: Sensitivity: the frozen run repeated on 2026-11-12 with one assumption changed (who holds the side choice in quarterfinal game 1). A what-if.

derivation_text.saved: Saved in the frozen prediction file on 2026-11-10.
derivation_text.computed_from_frozen_inputs: Computed on 2026-11-13 from the frozen inputs (same ratings, H, q and sigma) by score.py; not saved on 2026-11-10.
derivation_text.walk_forward_replay: Replayed after the event, using only earlier games.
